title: Advanced Features
description: Explore React Suspense, query cancellation, custom hooks, and error handling strategies.
longDescription: This module covers advanced React Query features for production applications. You will integrate React Suspense for declarative loading states, cancel queries with AbortController, build reusable custom query hooks, and implement robust error handling strategies including global error boundaries and retry policies.
whatYouLearn: Use React Suspense with React Query
Configure retry policies and error boundaries
